label: copy phase: fed-back "2" when the next output is also "2" (repeated 2-2)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase and only when the input token is the digit 2 (100% of activations have in_tok=2; none in original or delimiter phase). The strong activations are where the fed-back 2 is followed by another 2 being output, i.e. copying a "2 2" run (out_tok=2 holds ~75% of mass; top examples are all ...2 2... with activation highest at the first 2 of the run, recall_idx 2-3). Does not fire at recall_idx 0-1 ("2 2" at the start of the sequence gives false positives). Weak tail (~25% of mass, mostly low quartiles) on fed-back 2 followed by other tokens, enriched for u/h/g/3 outputs and recall_idx 2-4. Predicate dev: P=0.86, R=0.47, F1=0.61, mass recall 0.74; recall is limited by the weak non-2-2 tail.
